review.notes: Triage review of all 60 physical pages: full fence-balance scan, plus automated normalized unigram and 4-gram containment of every PDF page's text layer against the OCR markdown; pages listed were inspected in detail from their diff contexts. Line-by-line review with rendered pages was done for the appendix prompt pages 57-58 (120 dpi renders, plus 300 dpi crops of the p.58 box tail) and the p.7 Table 2 footnote (300 dpi crop). The 4-gram misses on chart/table pages come from PDF reading order, figure-internal axis/legend text and PDF kerning glues, not droppage; word-level containment shows no other missing content words. Table bodies exist as HTML (Tables 2, 3, 23-26 spot-checked against the text layer, not exhaustively cell-by-cell); references match the PDF's [1]-[14]; the odd grammar 'we add the following to phrases ... at the end the instruction section' is printed by the PDF itself and was left unchanged.

patches.evidence: Completes the 4-backtick nesting of the two appendix prompt boxes verified on rendered physical p.57 and p.58: the claim-listing box closes after "{response}" (bottom of p.57) and the fact-checking box opens after the "Fact-checking prompt:" label (top of p.58). With the previous 3-backtick fences, the label line was swallowed into the following code block and the boxes rendered truncated; after this patch the repository pipeline renders exactly two code blocks and no spurious headings.

Dropped prompt-box tail restored from physical p.58 (printed 57), verified on the page render and a 300 dpi crop: after the JSON example's closing fence the fact-checking box continues "### Task / Prompt: / {prompt} / Response: / {response} / Claims: / {claims}" with blank lines before "Response:" and "Claims:"; the string {claims} was absent from the OCR markdown. The patch also closes the fact-checking box with a 4-backtick fence so the printed inner ```json fences stay literal.
